name: alert
description: Inline callout for user attention with default and destructive variants, title, description, and an optional action.
purpose: Keeps important success, warning, and error messages on the current page without blocking the rest of the UI.
bestFor: inline error recovery with an action
avoidFor: modal dialogs that require a decision

files.content:
export { Alert, AlertAction, AlertDescription, AlertTitle } from "./Alert";
export type * from "./Alert.types";

examples.code: {alertMocks.basic.title} {alertMocks.basic.description} {alertMocks.destructive.title} {alertMocks.destructive.description} {alertMocks.action.title} {alertMocks.action.description}
